title: Menashya bar Menachem
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Shabbat 144b: They said, as it was taught — "And those of the house of Menashya bar Menachem would squeeze pomegranates." Rav Nachman said: The halakhah follows those of the house of Menashya bar Menachem. Rava said to him: Is Menashya bar Menachem a Tanna? Is Menashya bar Menachem the majority of the world?

And in Yuchasin he wrote that he lived in the time of Rav, and Seder HaDorot rightly challenged this: from where does he have this? And in the complete Yuchasin it says that he lived in the time of Rabbi [Yehudah HaNasi], but from where does he have this? Hyman suggests that it was written in Yuchasin "in the time of רב״י," which is an abbreviation of "Rabbi Yehudah," and he derived this from Shabbat there, where they said: We have found that Rabbi Yehudah concedes to the Rabbis — [but] that the Rabbis concede to Rabbi Yehudah, from where do we have it? From what was taught: "And those of the house of Menashya bar Menachem" — infer from this that it is [the view of] the Rabbis; infer from this that those of the house of Menachem were [of that opinion], etc. And from this the Yuchasin derived that he was in the days of Rabbi Yehudah.

notes.text: Shabbat 144b directly supplies the household’s pomegranate practice and Rava’s objections. Hyman’s Rav/Rabbi reports, literal רב״י expansion and Rabbi Yehudah chronology conjecture remain his argument; the exact Yuchasin editions were not independently inspected.
